purpose.domain_detail: Domestic hot water energy savings calculator — computes water usage, energy consumption (BTUs), fuel consumption, and cost for initial vs. new shower conditions, then reports savings
purpose.summary: DHWSAVE is an interactive batch program that prompts the user for cold water temperature, fuel type (electric/natural gas/propane), hot water temperature, flow rate, shower time, and combustion efficiency for both initial and new conditions. It calculates water usage, energy in BTUs, fuel consumed, and cost for each scenario, then displays a savings report comparing the two.

notable_features: FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL and FUNCTION NUMVAL for numeric input validation (COBOL intrinsic functions)
EVALUATE TRUE used extensively for menu-driven input validation
GO TO used for input retry loops (33 occurrences)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL
Detailed WORKING-STORAGE with conversion factors for electricity/natural gas/propane
Edited PIC clauses with $, Z, + signs for formatted output
PERFORM-based structured main flow with numbered paragraph names
